extDescription.message: Adds the videos in your YouTube Watch Later to Clew's Later pile, on this Mac.

pairHint.message: In Clew, open Settings › Browser and click Pair Chrome. Type the code here.

pairErrorCode.message: That code didn't work. Check it in Clew's Settings, or start pairing again there.

statusWaiting.message: Paired. Open your Watch Later page to import it.

statusRevoked.message: Clew no longer knows this browser. Unpair, then pair again.

statusFailed.message: The last import didn't work. It will try again on your next visit.

statusNeedsUpdate.message: YouTube changed its page. Nothing was removed; this extension needs an update.
